info.title: Classify Issue API
info.description: Classifies a One-Click Report issue based on the agent description text and optional error data into predefined categories.

post.summary: Classify a One-Click Report issue into a category
post.description: Takes the agent's free-text description and optional parsed error data, then classifies the issue into categories: LATENCY, UI_ERROR, AUTH_ERROR, DATA_ERROR, or UNKNOWN. Also flags whether a user interaction recording review is needed.

description.description: The agent-entered free-text description of the issue from the One-Click Report

error_data.description: Optional stringified error data from Vlocity/Exception logs for additional classification context

recording_review_needed.description: Whether the user interaction recording should be reviewed for accurate root cause identification

matched_keywords.description: Keywords from the description that triggered the classification
